# The Lion

> A Christian education and cultural commentary publication from the Herzog Foundation covering faith, policy, and American civic life.

The Lion publishes investigative reporting and analysis on Christian education, government policy, culture, and religion. The publication features staff writers and contributing journalists covering topics ranging from education policy and school choice to evangelical politics and election integrity.

## Key Topics

- Christian education
- Education policy
- School choice
- Child safety
- AI regulation
- Evangelical politics
- Government policy
- Election integrity
- Culture and religion
- Trump administration
- Israel
- Herzog Foundation
- The Daily Signal
- News roundup
- School curriculum

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://readlion.com): The Lion homepage with news on Christian education, culture, and policy
- [About The Lion](https://readlion.com/about): About The Lion: Herzog Foundation publication on faith, culture, and families
- [Podcasts](https://readlion.com/podcasts): Weekly news roundup podcasts on education and families
- [Press](https://readlion.com/press): Press coverage and media citations for The Lion publication

## Education & Culture Coverage

- [Christian education will sustain America, preserve founding principles, advocates say](https://readlion.com/christian-education-will-sustain-america-preserve-founding-principles-advocates-say): Michaela Estruth on Christian education and American founding principles
- [Poll: Evangelicals see End Times as near, but support for Israel goes beyond prophecy](https://readlion.com/evangelicals-see-end-times-as-near-but-support-for-israel-goes-beyond-prophecy-poll-says): Michael Foust on evangelical beliefs, Israel support, and religious demographics
- [White House AI framework requires measures to protect kids; child safety advocates want more](https://readlion.com/white-house-ai-framework-requires-measures-to-protect-kids-child-safety-advocates-want-more): Elizabeth Troutman Mitchell on White House AI framework and child safety

## Government & Politics Coverage

- [Lawmakers fail to end second-longest shutdown in history](https://readlion.com/lawmakers-fail-to-end-second-longest-shutdown-in-history): Andi Shae Napier on government shutdown and federal agency funding
- [Fulton County numbers don't match after FBI seizure](https://readlion.com/fulton-county-numbers-dont-match-after-fbi-seizure): Fred Lucas investigates election integrity issues in Fulton County, Georgia
